name: aosp_build
description: Build and test in an AOSP tree. lunch: choose the build target (no target: list the tree's targets). m: build Soong modules (no modules: the modules that own the changed files; never the whole platform). atest: run tests (no tests: the ones tests_for picks). tests_for: which test modules cover some files, from TEST_MAPPING and Android.bp. lunch, m and atest run in the session's shell like run_command (envsetup.sh is sourced, the lunch target is kept). Not for: Gradle or app builds outside the tree (run_command), reading a saved build log (triage action build). Example: {"action": "m", "modules": ["CarService"]}. Output: the build's summary and errors, or the test list with the reason for each test.

paths.description: tests_for/atest: changed files (default: the files changed in git and this task)

timeout.description: seconds before the build moves to the background
